training_eeg: uniform k in {2,3,4}; sample trials without replacement
preprocessing: per-electrode training moments from standard full averages
calibration: matched training rows, standard four-repeat average EEG
attention: pre-normalized self-attention over 17 electrodes, before temporal convolution
gate: Top-5 >= +1pp and Top-1 >= 0pp; at least 3/4 subjects improve Top-5
query: standard four-repeat average, fixed 200 templates and 1000 queries
